title: Workmanship Free-Replacement Limits by Line — Tire Sets & Treadwear Limited Warranty
content:
Workmanship coverage on Tire Sets & Treadwear Limited Warranty sets: a tire with a manufacturing defect is replaced free while it is inside both of its line's free-replacement limits — a number of months from the purchase date and an amount of tread worn (new-tire depth less the measured depth). After free replacement ends, the customer's share of the replacement is figured on the line's proration basis, and the line states whether mounting and balancing is then charged.

| Line | Free-replacement months | Free-replacement tread worn | Basis of the customer's share after the free period | Mounting and balancing charged after the free period |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Crestline Value Touring 40K Treadwear Warranty | 12 months | 2/32 in | tread-worn share | Yes |
| Crestline All-Season 50K Treadwear Warranty | 12 months | 2/32 in | tread-worn share | Yes |
| Crestline Grand Touring 60K Treadwear Warranty | 12 months | 2/32 in | tread-worn share | Yes |
| Crestline Highway Terrain LT 65K Treadwear Warranty | 12 months | 2/32 in | tread-worn share | Yes |
| Crestline Premium Touring 75K Treadwear Warranty | 12 months | 2/32 in | tread-worn share | Yes |
| Crestline Ultra Touring 85K Treadwear Warranty | 24 months | 3/32 in | tread-worn share | No |

The Crestline Ultra Touring 85K Treadwear Warranty line has the longest free period, 24 months and 3/32 in of tread worn, and does not charge mounting and balancing after it; the other five lines replace free for 12 months and 2/32 in of tread worn and charge mounting and balancing afterwards.

**Free-replacement limits, both sides (hypothetical tires):** on a line with a 2/32 in limit and a new depth of 10/32 in, a tire measured at 8/32 in has 2/32 in worn and is inside the wear limit, while one measured at 7/32 in has 3/32 in worn and is past it.
